chunks: Surely the Hour will be the moment of their promise, and that moment will be calamitous and distressing.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the timing and nature of the Hour for disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the certainty of the Hour as the ultimate reckoning for those who denied resurrection, framing it not merely as a future event but as the precise moment of their accountability. The description of the Hour as 'more calamitous and bitter' (adha wa amarr) reflects the intensification of divine punishment for those who mocked the prophets, serving as a stern warning to the faithful about the gravity of the Day of Judgment.
